programme.title: Secrets of the Flaming Mountains Ep.1
programme.desc: In 908, a Central Asian expedition to the Flaming Mountains in Xinjiang, China, made a startling discovery—mummified remains buried in the Astana Cemetery, unlocking a mystery over a thousand years old. Meanwhile, a revered Buddhist monk and a Central Asian king forged a life-and-death bond—one of the most extraordinary friendships in Buddhist history. But what really happened? And what would eventually lead to the fall of the once-thriving Gaochang Kingdom.
